translation.name: Dillꞌ wen dillꞌ   Kob C̱he   Jesucrístonaꞌ

book.name: Apocalipsis
book.title: Jesucrístona' bliile' Juanna' c̱he diika' zi' gak

content: Wseje' dii x̱iwaa' to mil yiz
Na' ble'id' to anjl chetje' yabana', na' nox̱ee xiiṉya c̱he yecha' daa bi chiyoll chido nak zitj na' nox̱ee sto gden xen.
Na' anjla' bc̱heje' bayix̱' xṉana', bana' nak beḻ kani'teyi, ḻeban dii x̱iwaa na' Satanáza', na' bc̱heje'n to mil yiz.
Na' bzaḻeen ḻoo yecha' daa bi chiyoll chido nak zitj, na' bsejtipe'n kwenc̱he shejan to mil yiz na' bich siye'n beṉ' yell-lioka'. Ka yiyoll gak to mil yiz na' yiselle'n xtit.

Na'ch ble'id' gana' llia beṉ'ka' gok lo na'gake' gongake' yeḻ' josc̱hisa'. Na' ḻekzka' ble'id' beṉ'ka' bc̱hoggake' yene'ka' ni c̱heyi daa be'gake' xtill' Jesúza' na' cho'a xtill' Chioza'. Ḻegaken' bi be'la'ogake' bayix̱aa bchej ḻoo nisdo'na' ni bi be'gake' latj ta' seṉ c̱heba' loxgue'ka' wa neeka'. Na' bibangake' sto shii na' wṉabia'lengake' Crístona' to mil yiz.
Ḻegaken' beṉ' nechka' yiban ladj beṉ' wetka'. Na' beṉ' wetka' sto, ka biyollch bza' de to mil yiza' bibangake'.

Chakomba beṉ'ka' yiban nech ladj beṉ' wetka', ḻa' beṉ'kan' nak lall' na' Chioza'. Na' bi ile'gakile' yeḻ' wit wchopina', san gakgake' bx̱oz c̱he Chioza' na' c̱he Crístona' na' iṉabia'lengake'ne' to mil yiz.
Kat' yiyoll iza' de to mil yiza', yiselle' Satanáza' gana' nc̱heje'n.

Na' tan siye'n beṉ'ka' lle' tap ḻaate yell-lioni, beṉ'ka' zaklebgake' beṉ'ka' lle' yellka' le Gog na' Magog, na' wtopan ḻegake' kwenc̱he shajlengake'n lo wdiḻa', na' gakgake' beṉ' be beṉ' zil ka yoxa' chi' cho'a nisdo'na'.

Na' bllesh bcheeṉgake' doxen lo yell-lioni na' wyec̱hjgake' yella' daa ḻe chaki Chioza', gana' lle' beṉ'ka' nak lall' nee, nan wlliayi'gake' ḻegake'. Per Chioza' bḻetje' yi'na' xan yabana' bisya bisḻenan ḻegake'.

Na' bzaḻee dii x̱iwaa, daa wxiye'n ḻegake', lo yi' gabiḻa' daa nc̱hix̱' azúfrena', gana' bzaḻee bayix̱aa bchej ḻoo nisa' na' bana' wdix̱jeeb xtill'ba'. Nan' illaglogakan yeḻ' zak'zi'na' ka tella ka waḻ zejḻi kaṉi.
Chioza' gone' yeḻ' josc̱his c̱he beṉ' wetka'
Na' ble'id' gana' llia Chioza' chṉabi'e, nakan to dii llyish na' to dii xen. Na' lawe'na' binitlo yell-lioni len yabana', na' koch no ble'i ḻegakan.

Na' ble'id' beṉ' wetka', ka beṉ' zakii na' ka beṉ' bi zakii, zegake' lao Chioza' gana' llie' chṉabi'e. Na' bsalje' librka', na'tech bsalje' sto libr yoblə gana' da' le beṉ'ka' de yeḻ' mban c̱heyin zejḻi kaṉi. Na' bene' yeḻ' josc̱his c̱he beṉ' wetka' kon ka choe' librka' dill' ben to toe'.
Na' biban yog' beṉ'ka' wit ḻoo nisdo'na', na' beṉ' wetka' lle' latj c̱he yeḻ' wita' gana' le Hades,
na' yog'ḻoḻgake' gok yeḻ' josc̱his c̱he'ka' kon ka ben to toe'.
Na'ch ḻekzka' bzaḻ' Chioza' yeḻ' wita' na' latja' le Hades lo yi' gabiḻa'. Na' lo yi' gabiḻan' nakan yeḻ' wit wchopina'.
Na' bzaḻee lo yi' gabiḻa' beṉ'ka' bi da' lie'ka' ḻee libra' gana' da' le beṉ'ka' de yeḻ' mban c̱heyin zejḻi kaṉi.
